findings.title: audible join: place_spell.mp3 + h.mp3 + u.mp3 + t.mp3
findings.detail: The target sound /t/ is completely missing and the audio cuts off after /ʌ/. The phonemes sound isolated and stitched together. (judge 3/10; heard: kən juː spɛl h ʌ)

findings.title: audible join: fs_mug.mp3 + m.mp3
findings.detail: The prompt is bright and clear, but the target sound /m/ drops considerably in volume and clarity, sounding noticeably spliced in. (judge 6/10; heard: mʌɡ stɑːts wɪð mː)
